seasonal_guidance.optimalWindow: Mid-July through October, per prior research on this route

July.reason: Season opens mid-July; brush and vegetation still wet/thick early in the month, drying out by late July

August.reason: Driest rock and clearest conditions of the season, though watch for afternoon thunderstorms

October.reason: Wetter and colder later in the month; still viable early October but conditions degrade

September.reason: Continues the best window with typically stable, drier weather before fall wetness sets in

seasonal_guidance.optimalWindow: Mid-July through September (per prior research), with late July-August the most reliable window

July.reason: Early July can still hold significant snow; by mid-July conditions typically firm up into the optimal window noted in prior research

June.reason: Still largely snowbound with a long snowy approach and elevated avalanche/glacier hazard, consistent with the existing spring/early-summer climate notes

August.reason: Most reliable conditions - snow largely consolidated or melted, glacier remnant more manageable, generally the most stable weather

September.reason: Good late-season option with minimal snow coverage, but early-season storms and shorter days become a factor toward month's end

seasonal_guidance.optimalWindow: Roughly late June through September, bounded by Highway 20's seasonal closure over Washington Pass (typically closed ~Nov-Apr); only two dated route-specific data points exist (Sept 14, 2000 FA; Aug 26, 2005 ascent), so treat as inferred from Washington Pass rock-season norms rather than route-verified month-by-month.

May.reason: A late-May (Memorial Day) 2005 attempt on this exact ridge found 'bottomless muck' snow low on route and was turned back by an afternoon lightning storm.

August.reason: An Aug 26, 2005 extended ridge traverse ascent is documented as going reasonably well condition-wise.

September.reason: The Sept 14, 2000 first ascent was completed in this month -- the only FA-quality data point.

seasonal_guidance.optimalWindow: Narrow -- both known ascents occurred in mid-to-late July (FA: July 19-20, 2002; second ascent: mid-July 2013), consistent with the general North Cascades glaciated-objective season via Cascade Pass; no explicit month-by-month guidance exists beyond these two data points.

July.reason: Both documented ascents (the only two known climbs of this route) occurred in this month.
